name: Tinker: the Laser Beam talent's Sticky Bomb does not lock the client's Sticky Bomb button (#12207)
contract: Talent 706680: Laser Beam (805372) damage casts Sticky Bomb 500612 on the target. The talent cast is triggered,
so the server stores no cooldown, but the client starts category 742's cooldown from SMSG_SPELL_GO and greys
out every Sticky Bomb button (the report). After the triggered cast the server must send SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN
(478) for 500612, as Venomancer and Sun Cleric #11484 do. The spell_proc chance is 100, so the proc is certain.
A Sticky Bomb the player cast by hand keeps its real cooldown: the talent does not reset it, so the server
keeps the cooldown and sends no clear packet (CodeRabbit review of #12325). That phase runs first, before the
Mechsuit, and the manual cooldown is then reset as a fixture for the triggered phase.

steps.label: Let spawn AI settle
Fixture: ranged gun
Equip the gun
The Laser Beam Sticky Bomb talent
SETUP: the talent aura is on
Sticky Bomb itself
Throw Sticky Bomb by hand
SETUP: the manual Sticky Bomb has a server cooldown
Mechsuit is on
Let the global cooldown clear
The talent throws a Sticky Bomb during the manual cooldown
Give a clear packet time to arrive
DISCRIMINATING: the manual Sticky Bomb cooldown is kept
DISCRIMINATING: no SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN for the manual cooldown
Fixture: end the manual Sticky Bomb cooldown
Fixture: Laser Beam ready again
Let the global cooldown clear
Laser Beam hits its target
The talent puts Sticky Bomb on the target
The triggered Sticky Bomb leaves no server cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: the server clears the client's Sticky Bomb cooldown with SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN for 500612
